runner_rule: root package.json dependencies, devDependencies and scripts, and the root config files (b1.ts rootRunners), read only for repositories not excluded or archived whose licence is permissive or pending the second read
licence_rule: GraphQL licenseInfo.spdxId on prereg.json's licences is kept; null or NOASSERTION is kept with second_read_pending true and its raw spdxId, for section 5's second read; any other is dropped as licence_not_permissive
